Advanced.learningGoal: Parse and slice data without allocating, using Span<T> and ReadOnlySpan<char>.
gotchas: Span<T> can't be stored in fields of classes or used across await
Substring allocates; slicing a span doesn't
goodSolutionShows: ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing with no intermediate strings
Clear bounds checks and no index-out-of-range
shapeHints: splitting a CSV line without Split

Expert.learningGoal: Combine Memory<T>, ArrayPool and IBufferWriter for allocation-free pipelines.
gotchas: Returning a rented array twice or using it after return
Memory<T> is needed when the buffer must survive an await
Rented arrays can be larger than requested
goodSolutionShows: Memory<T> across async boundaries, Span<T> inside sync methods
Respecting the actual length, not array.Length
shapeHints: a log line formatter writing into IBufferWriter<char>
